sample_unit: male pelvic CT scans (auto-contours from three software packages; 291 rationale outputs rated)

links.outcome: Error-detection (sensitivity/specificity) of LLM-based QA screening of auto-contours against radiation oncologist ground truth
links.effect: Weighted kappa 0.730–0.798 across software; cutoff ≥4 gave highest sensitivity in rectum (0.976) and highest specificity in left femoral head (0.933); potential overestimation bias risks missing inadequate cases.
links.quote: A cutoff of ≥4 as “adequate “ narrowed the CIs, yielding the highest sensitivity in the rectum (0.976) and the highest specificity in the left femoral head (0.933).

links.outcome: Agreement of automated AI-output quality checks with clinician ground-truth review
links.effect: The LLM QA tool showed moderate to strong agreement with expert judgments (ρ 0.733–0.794; quadratic weighted κ 0.730–0.798) across software.
links.quote: The LAQUA system demonstrated moderate to strong agreement with expert judgments across all evaluated software (ρ: 0.733–0.794; quadratic weighted κ: 0.730–0.798) and organs (ρ: 0.567–0.835; quadratic weighted κ: 0.639–0.804).

links.outcome: Whether automated LLM checks detect inadequate AI auto-contours where human review is burdensome
links.effect: High sensitivity for detecting inadequate contours at cutoff ≥4 (rectum 0.976), though overestimation bias may miss some inadequate cases; suggests feasibility as primary screening.
links.quote: While potential overestimation bias (risk of missing “inadequate” cases) warrants caution, the observed sensitivity suggests its feasibility as a primary screening QA tool to efficiently filter acceptable contours, thereby reducing the clinical workload.

Evaluating LLM rationales for hallucination, error detection, and anatomical understanding

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal LLM-based quality assurance (LAQUA) system as an automated safeguard/screening tool to verify AI auto-contouring quality against radiation oncologist ground truth.

primary.practice: automated AI quality assurance and secondary screening for auto-contouring
